messages:
maria: Heads up — I have a reliable repro for the KV cache misaligned append that shows up for long-context playback (>64k tokens). Repro steps below. :eyes:

maria: Repro log sample:
```
2026-03-16T14:12:03.123Z kv_write: page_id=12 write_offset=4099 expected_offset=4096 tokens_written=3 request_id=req-abc123
2026-03-16T14:12:03.124Z kv_read: page_id=12 read_offset=4096 tokens=...
```

aj: Can you paste the minimal repro command?
maria: Yep — run locally with the long playback harness:
```
python tests/runtime/test_kv_long_context.py::test_misaligned_append --seed=42 --iterations=1000
```

simon: Quick guess: writer is computing offsets in bytes after compression but reader expects token-aligned offsets, so when a small block gets compressed differently we end up +3 bytes. Could be integer division / rounding issue in block packing.

kyle: I saw a customer incident that looked like this last week — same symptoms (stale tokens from previous request showing up). Filed INC-789 but we never nailed the root cause.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-789 created by kyle (link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-789)

eva: Two short-term fixes: 1) add a request_id header on each KVPage and assert on reads that page.request_id == current_request_id (helps prevent cross-request contamination) 2) strong assert for page_offset % token_alignment == 0 in debug builds.
aj: Perf impact? Extra header per page ~8 bytes and one comparison on reads. Negligible for correctness-first fix.
simon: Also add a unit test that intentionally forces compression variance (use tiny RNG seeds) so we fail fast.
maria: I'll draft a PR with both assert + unit test. Also going to add an integration job that replays the long context for 24h to watch memory growth.
kyle: FYI the prod trace showed memory drift coincident with misaligned writes — when reader saw misaligned offset it re-interpreted bytes as KV entries and grew internal maps. That matches the mem growth we're seeing in the stress runs.
eva: If we tag pages by request_id we should also sanitize on eviction: if page.request_id != current_request_id clear KVPage to avoid ghost blocks on reuse.

aj: one more ask — can you add a tiny perf microbenchmark showing cost of the check on hot path? We should be able to show <1% tail latency delta.
maria: Will do. PR link when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/XXXX (WIP).
simon: I'll review the packing code path (kv_packer.cc) tomorrow. I suspect an off-by-one in pack_block() when leftover_bytes >= MIN_PAD triggers wrong align.
kyle: planning to run the long-playback stress on dedicated-qa (`dedicated-qa/kv-heavy`) starting tonight. Will report back in the morning. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks — appreciate the fast triage. If anyone sees other weirdness (stale cache reads, cross-request tokens) drop logs here and tag me.
